# `movea.l SocketBase,a6` / `jsr d16(a6)` pairs counted.  A raw `4E AE` scan
# over-counts about fivefold -- AmiFTP 1.843 really calls 18 vectors and the
# raw scan claimed 89 -- so a raw hit is never evidence.
# kind:    lvo      keyed by the api name in lvo-matrix.tsv
#          feature  something with no vector, keyed by its option
# status:  BREAKS   the profile stops the program working
#          DEGRADED the program runs but cannot do its job
#          CLEAN    proven NOT called, so the stub is free

column1: # Batch D and F, 2026-09-07.  Servers and mail clients.

column6: ungated in every profile; NOT universal -- net.lib init_inet_daemon() daemons (lpd, identd) never call it
no ROUTING/DNS/ADDRALLOC/NETMONITOR/NETSTATUS/ADDRINFO/BPF vector called by any of the seven; none does reverse DNS either, they log numeric addresses

AveHTTPD stores the bsdsocket AND AS225 socket.library base in the SAME global (0xfde0), a mode flag at 0xfddc selects. Proving SocketBase from its OpenLibrary store is NOT sufficient -- partition by the cmp #1/beq branch or the scan invents ProcessIsServer, GetRouteInfo, gethostbyaddr
gcc/ixemul daemons expose ZERO bsdsocket vectors; the whole contract lives inside ixemul.library. A vector scan files them CLEAN and is wrong

FIXED: was bsd_enosys in every profile, so telnetd's 4 calls, lpd's 8, AmiFTPd's 28+ and POPd's went nowhere on the default build too. Implemented via ami_log_raw() for about 250 bytes; the library already stored SBTC_LOGTAGPTR/LOGSTAT/LOGFACILITY and discarded the calls that used them

column1: # Batch E, 2026-09-07.  Browsers, download managers and IRC.

column6: SOCK_RAW IS recoverable after all: the type argument is a constant immediate at every socket() site in this corpus (socket(2,1,0) / (2,1,6) / pea 0,pea 1,pea 2). Decoding the arguments answers what the LVO table cannot, and would have caught AvePING

the single named cause of every false BREAKS: exec PutMsg/GetMsg/ReplyMsg/WaitPort (-366..-384) alias bpf_open/close/read/write, CloseLibrary(-414) aliases AddRouteTagList, CreatePool..FreePooled(-696..-714) alias ObtainServerSocket and the DNS group, AllocMem/FreeMem(-198/-210) alias Inet_MakeAddr/gethostbyname, dos Open..Input(-30..-54) alias socket/bind/listen/accept/connect, gadtools SetGadgetAttrsA(-42) aliases listen with 28 hits in HTTPResume alone
the naive scan reports getaddrinfo on HTTPResume, and that API postdates the corpus -- so the tripwire fires automatically and proves the scan wrong without a human noticing
eight binaries, SocketBase proven in every one, exhaustive slot enumeration rather than heuristics: zero calls to anything minimal stubs
found by screening, and a hit is trustworthy even though an absence is not: the scanner has zero false positives but under-reports. Another inetd-family member
ELEVEN of sixty are ixemul-hosted and therefore invisible to any vector scan -- 18 per cent, not a rare case. Coverage figures overstate real coverage by roughly that much

tools/aminet-scan.py reported ONE vector for mail clients that plainly open sockets, so its absences mean nothing; its positives are still sound (zero false positives against hand-verified truth). CLEAN may never rest on it
